contributors.FreeCAD fcprobe: Lower-tier RTX (Turing) limit simulation for the Vulkan renderer probes.

VP_NVIDIA_rtx_2060.label: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (Turing limit simulation)
VP_NVIDIA_rtx_2060.description: A constrained lower-tier RTX (Turing) limit set: a finite maxMemoryAllocationCount instead of the unbounded desktop value, exercised together with the post-Turing extension exclusions in the rtx-2060 device profile. NOTE: the Vulkan Profiles schema can override only device LIMITS (not deviceName/deviceID/deviceType, and not memory heaps), so this simulates capability/limit degradation, not device identity or 6 GB VRAM.
